Tessa / Vivek,

Legal is broadly comfortable with a limited trade as long as we:
- Keep any logo use to an approved artwork file and a single placement per channel (no automatic sublicensing),

- Keep the quote short and factual (no health claims), and include a short "customer" attribution line (e.g., "BrightLeaf Health, Head of Partnerships").

I will draft a one-paragraph marketing addendum and a short legal clause for the SOW. Important: if Discount >= 18% we should route to finance/leadership for approval (discount policy threshold). 15% we can approve through Deal Desk.

- Approval of final webinar slides and a 1-page landing page (we will co-brand),
- Right of first refusal to amplify the webinar content in our owned channels for up to 6 months (not paid),
- A small case-study follow-up (email blurb + 2-sentence quote) that we can include in an upcoming customer digest.

If we cap the discount to 15% + the above deliverables, this looks like a net positive — limited risk and good content.

Thanks team. Per Laura and Marissa, I'm comfortable with an exception here but want to set firm guardrails. Approved terms (exec ok):
- Discount: 18% for one year (deal_id BL-2027-0892) — one-time exception; finance notified.
- Marketing: 1 co-branded webinar (Redwood review present), three paid social posts (max 3 months), and a short 2-sentence quote.
- Logo/quote usage: allowed up to 12 months for static assets only; no endorsement language; Redwood to approve all creative prior to publish.
- We keep rights to repurpose the webinar on owned channels for 6 months for non-paid use.
- Any extensions or additional content requests require renewed Exec approval.

Tessa — please communicate the terms to the customer and attach the marketing addendum Laura will produce. I've notified finance that this exceeds Deal Desk autonomy.

-Vivek

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the form. We discussed internally and can move forward on a one-time exception with firm guardrails:

Offer: 18% volume discount for 12 months in exchange for:
- 1 co-branded webinar (Redwood presence on the panel),
- Up to 3 paid social posts (campaign duration max 3 months),
- Short 2-sentence quote and logo usage for static assets for up to 12 months.

Conditions:
- Redwood will approve all webinar slides, social creative, and the final quote prior to use; marketing assets must avoid health claims and endorsements;
- Redwood retains the right to publish the webinar in owned channels for non-paid amplification for up to 6 months after the live event;
- Any additional uses, extensions, or paid amplifications beyond the agreed scope require renewed executive approval.

Next steps: Laura will circulate a short marketing addendum to attach to the SOW (see cc). Once BrightLeaf confirms acceptance, we'll proceed to get signatures.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
